I saw my father crying over some mutual business partners' loss and somebody telling me that my father is already burnt. It was such a painful dream that I woke up with tears in my eyes. I gathered from it that my father has spent much on us and much of it is from Sood. So do not pressurize him for more expenditures so that he is forced to stick to Sood. I quit my plans for study abroad, and I have been trying for him to leave all Soodi investments. But when i think that the dream said "he is already burnt" i feel perhaps it is no use. The sin has amounted so much that Allah na karae, but he will burn in hell for sure. So I get disheartened. I also get disheartened because he has started taking out money from Soodi investments upon our insistence but he does not really consider it a sin. He says it is not that kind of forbidden Sood. answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 45096 Country: KW Title: Credit Card Usage Question: I need to know about credit card usage. There is an agreement in case of late fees there is an interest. So it is possible for us to avoid interest. But my question is there is an agreement on interest payment which is haram and the credit card is not the necessity of life now. There are other alternatives of credit card like prepaid card which works same as credit card. People are going for credit card only to enjoy its offers and benefits like airport lounge access for free which can be arrange by paying cash if you do not have the card, so in other word now credit card is not the necessity but to enjoy the luxurious of this world and to save money on different items and airport lounges. Please tell me after go through the above details, is it still halal to use credit card, is still halal to agree to pay interest if you are late means you will pay as you agreed on it? Answer ID: 45096 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1256/B-317/TB=9/1434) The condition of credit card in which interest is levied is unlawful. If there is no interest i.e. it is only to reach free of cost to airport lounge then it shall be like a pass and there will be no harm. And now when the prepaid card is available which works like credit card it is unnecessary to question about the permissibility of the credit card. In case of late fees paying interest is unlawful, though you have agreed on paying interest. Any haram work shall not turn lawful after agreement. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
